messages:
Nia (CSM): Polaris sent over a vendor risk form and flagged a few items as renewal blockers: 'do you use customer inputs to fine-tune models?' and 'how do you delete customer data from retired models?'. They want evidence by EOD. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/polaris_q1.png

Ethan (Security): Quick answer: we DO NOT use customer content to train public/open models. Hosted API logs are retained 7 days by default (configurable for enterprise). Embeddings retention is configurable; we offer opt-in deletion. @Lina please confirm legal phrasing. :mag:

Lina (Legal): Suggested legal line: "Redwood Inference does not use Customer Content to train, improve, or fine-tune models absent an explicit, signed opt-in amendment." Uploading draft clause: https://drive.redwood/legal/polaris_clause_draft.docx

Raj (Infra): For retired model artifacts we run a secure wipe workflow. Example delete call for org-level data:
```
POST /internal/admin/delete_org_data
{"org_id":"polaris-93","scope":"embeddings,request_logs","cutoff":"2026-03-01"}
```
Wipe completes within 72hrs of decommission. I can export audit logs.

Nia (CSM): Polaris asked for 1) policy statement 2) export of recent request logs 3) signed clause in renewal packet. @Raj can you run export for polaris-93?

Raj (Infra): Running `tools/export_audit --org polaris-93 --range 2025-01-01:2026-03-01 --types=request,retention` — ETA ~2h. Will share S3 link.

Ethan (Security): I'll attach SOC2 control mapping (section 6.2) and the standard questionnaire answers. Recommend we offer a 30-min technical call to walk through isolation options.

Lina (Legal): Clause drafted and approved by me pending minor wording. Nia, OK to include in renewal with a note: "no use for training unless amended"?

Nia (CSM): Yes. I'll assemble packet and propose a call next week. Thanks all :pray: 

forms-bot: Reminder: Polaris renewal date is 2026-04-10. Notification sent to CSMs.
